## Infrastructure & runtime
_Read from manifests, build files, and container configs. Absence means "not declared here", not "unused"._

**To stand it up, you'll need:** PostgreSQL, SQL via SQLAlchemy (ORM), SQLite, DB migrations (Alembic), Temporal (workflow engine), LangGraph (agent orchestration), AWS (boto3), S3 / MinIO object storage.

- **Web / API:** FastAPI (HTTP API), uvicorn (ASGI server)
- **Datastores:** PostgreSQL, SQL via SQLAlchemy (ORM), SQLite, DB migrations (Alembic)
- **Messaging / workers:** Temporal (workflow engine), LangGraph (agent orchestration)
- **Cloud / storage:** AWS (boto3), S3 / MinIO object storage
- **Observability:** OpenTelemetry (tracing), Jaeger (tracing)
- **Auth / crypto:** JWT auth
- **Domain / semantic:** RDF graph (rdflib), SHACL validation
- **Containers & deploy:** docker-compose: PostgreSQL, MinIO (S3 object storage), MinIO client, Temporal (workflow engine), Temporal UI, Jaeger (tracing)
- **Build & CI:** GitHub Actions
- **External services (env):** Anthropic API, Jira, Confluence
